title: Build a Lifecycle Trace Screen
prompt: Create an activity that records transitions and owns a visible-only observer through a lifecycle-aware API, then test launch, background, overlay, rotation, and return.
successCriteria: The trace distinguishes instance identity across recreation.
The observer runs only while the screen is visible.
No durable save depends solely on onDestroy.
